reason: This is a narrowing amendment. Disqualification engages s 12 NZBORA and is the heaviest sanction; leaving the forum as 'an independent court' permits a lower court or tribunal, and forum-shopping, to remove a candidate. Naming the High Court confines the power to the senior trial court with a full hearing, reasons, and appeal, while the serious, deliberate, sustained threshold and full-hearing guarantee are unchanged. It makes disqualification harder, not easier, to impose. No new power; no renumbering.
